decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album "Something for Everybody." Multiple distinct albums share this title, each attributed to different artists according to the provided sources. Document D1S1 attributes the album to Elvis Presley, D4S1 to Devo, and D5S1 to Baz Luhrmann. These are separate referents and valid answers under the same album title. No contradictory claims exist within the same referent, so all three are retained.
